crossRefs.note: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the…
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy…

translations.web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
translations.bsb: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
translations.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
translations.asv: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
